'''Exar Kun fresco''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. It depicted a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]] between [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]]<ref name="SWG" />&mdash;who died in [[3996 BBY]]<ref name="TSW6">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 6|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 6]]</ref>&mdash;wielding a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] with a [[Color/Legends|red]] blade, and a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Unidentified Twi'lek female Jedi|Twi'lek Jedi]] wielding a lightsaber with a blue blade who eventually fell to the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]. It was found by a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] during their assault on the [[Cult of Exar Kun]] in the catacombs beneath [[Temple of Exar Kun|Kun's temple]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Exar Kun fresco was a painting that appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]]. It was added to the game as part of the ''Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun'' game update on [[April 3]], [[2008]]. The fresco is one of the many items players could receive as loot after defeating the spirit of Exar Kun at the end of the Temple of Exar Kun "heroic encounter." The painting's description states that Exar Kun is facing a male opponent in the painting, but his opponent is actually a Twi'lek female. The fresco could be used in of the player's personal buildings as decoration.
